top_categories.workout_context: 78 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Belgrade Gran Fondo's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before October.
63ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
Belgrade Gran Fondo's mixed terrain forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 78 miles.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Belgrade Gran Fondo. Train it until it feels boring.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
At Belgrade Gran Fondo, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
Base fitness for Belgrade Gran Fondo. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
The aerobic base that lets you ride mixed terrain at tempo for 78 miles without cracking. No shortcuts.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Belgrade Gran Fondo, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 4,921ft of climbing on mixed terrain does to your power file on race day.

race_overlay.heat: October in Belgrade, Serbia (one-off 2017 event; no current edition — see eligibility) can bring heat. Complete 3–4 heat exposure sessions in the final 2 weeks before Belgrade Gran Fondo. Increase sodium intake 48 hours before race day.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for Belgrade Gran Fondo’s 78 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.
race_overlay.altitude: Moderate altitude at Belgrade Gran Fondo. Arrive 2–3 days early. Reduce intensity expectations by 5–10%. Hydrate aggressively.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Belgrade Gran Fondo requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on mixed terrain to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, Race Simulation, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 78 miles of mixed terrain in Belgrade, Serbia (one-off 2017 event; no current edition — see eligibility).
